definitions.uncertainty: Sample SD across the same three independent seeds; no pooling across evaluation examples.
definitions.current_mean: Mean of A1/B0/C0 accuracy at reported final/revision snapshots.
definitions.all4_mean: Mean of A0/A1/B0/C0 accuracy, including the superseded A0 rule.
definitions.current_curve: Mean of A0/B0/C0 before the observed revision cue, then A1/B0/C0; duplicate cue x shows the instantaneous rule switch.
definitions.revision_end: Evaluation immediately after the last A1 training block, which may precede later B0/C0 blocks.
definitions.first_B_before: B0 before its first feedback; actual A0/B0 agreement subsets and paired gains over initial B0 accuracy.
definitions.return_before: Before each condition's visits >= 2; per-condition averages are taken within seed before computing cross-seed SD.
definitions.compute: Online uses half the optimizer updates/training presentations. Only repeat and replay are compute matched.

checks: Each input manifest's full Cartesian product is complete, with no unindexed or duplicate results.
All six order/method combinations contain the same exactly three independent seed IDs.
Core configurations, parameter counts, and verified source snapshots match.
Per-seed teacher/world hashes, initial parameters, and per-condition external streams match.
Per-seed/order final buffer hashes match across methods.
Schedules, evaluation chains, checkpoints, return ages, and external/update budgets are complete.

manifest.selection: fixed final checkpoint; pilot validation only; no test selection
limits: Supervised environment labels, not self-evaluation or reward-only learning.
Explicit context and local rule-version cues; no autonomous change detection.
Uniform random-priority replay; no learned importance or learned replay scheduling.
Evaluation reads weights only; fixed-size raw buffer used exclusively for training.
The positive-positive quadrant is a narrow distribution-shift probe.
Online uses half the optimizer steps; repeat versus replay is the compute-matched comparison.
All methods maintain the same buffer; only replay reads it for learning.
